name: studymate-baseline-v1
description: Original, self-authored study passages and questions used by the deterministic evaluation harness. All content is written for this project; no third-party material is included.

corpus.text: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored as glucose. It takes place in the chloroplasts and releases oxygen as a by-product.
Chlorophyll is the green pigment inside chloroplasts that absorbs light energy for photosynthesis.
Cellular respiration converts glucose and oxygen into ATP, carbon dioxide and water, releasing usable energy for the cell.
Mitosis is a type of cell division that produces two genetically identical daughter cells for growth and repair.
Meiosis produces gametes with half the normal chromosome number and increases genetic variation through recombination.
Newton's first law states that an object remains at rest or in uniform motion unless acted on by a net external force.
Newton's second law states that force equals mass multiplied by acceleration.
Kinetic energy equals one half times mass times velocity squared.
